ACTUS-101 is an adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapy that aims to address the deficiency of acid-alpha-glucosidase (GAA) in patients with Pompe disease. GAA deficiency leads to deleterious progressive accumulation of glycogen in organs and tissues, especially skeletal and cardiac muscle, leading to high morbidity and premature death. The current standard of care for patients with Pompe is enzyme replacement therapy (ERT).
